_notes: E3 §6.2: letters from brothers of the province asking for help, on the pastor-asks model (systems/religious/confrereAsks.ts). `reputation` names what a friar must be known for to be asked; `orders` restricts to an order.

asks.label: Read his article
asks.blurb: {npc} has forty pages for a journal and would like a brother's eyes on it before the referee's, which means a fortnight of evenings and an honest paragraph he may not want.

asks.label: Cover his lectures
asks.blurb: {npc} is going into hospital for six weeks and his course at the studium cannot stop. He asks whether you would take it: his notes, your Tuesday, and twenty students who will compare.
asks.costs: two blocks a week for six weeks

asks.label: Translate the Latin for his book
asks.blurb: {npc} has a book nearly done and forty Latin passages in it that he cannot get into English that reads. He asks for a month of your desk, and offers a footnote.
asks.costs: a block a week for a month

asks.label: Preach his mission with him
asks.blurb: {npc} has a parish mission in Lent, four nights, and wants a second preacher so the box can be open while the other man is in the pulpit. It is the order's oldest way of doing it, two by two.
asks.costs: three blocks a week for two weeks

asks.label: Take his confessions while he is in Rome
asks.blurb: {npc} is in Rome for a month for the order's business and his Saturday box at the priory church is the busiest in the city. He asks whether you would sit in it.
asks.costs: a block a week for four weeks

asks.label: Proofread the province's newsletter
asks.blurb: {npc} edits the province's quarterly and the last issue misspelled the provincial. He asks for a week of your red pen, four times a year, starting now.
asks.costs: a block a week for a fortnight

asks.label: Teach the novices' catechesis class
asks.blurb: {npc} teaches the novices to teach, on Saturdays at the parish school, and has broken his ankle. He asks whether you would take the class for the term: eight novices, thirty children, and the Creed.
asks.costs: two blocks a week for eight weeks

asks.label: Help him write the chapter's report
asks.blurb: {npc} was made secretary of the commission on formation at the last chapter and has to produce forty pages by Advent. He asks for a hand with the part on studies, which is the part nobody agrees about.
asks.costs: a block a week for six weeks

asks.label: Write the necrology entry
asks.blurb: {npc} keeps the province's necrology and an old friar has died whom you knew and he did not. He asks for the two pages the province reads at table on the anniversary, for a century.
asks.costs: a block a week for three weeks

asks.label: Read his thesis chapter
asks.blurb: {npc} is a year from the licentiate and his director is on sabbatical. He asks whether you would read a chapter and tell him whether it is a chapter, before someone tells him at the defence.
asks.costs: a block a week for three weeks

asks.label: Drive the old friar to the hospital
asks.blurb: {npc} has been driving an old friar of his house to the hospital every Tuesday for dialysis and is being moved. He asks whether you would take the Tuesdays, which are long, and the old man, who is not.
asks.costs: a block a week for twelve weeks
